records.title: Hot-injection synthesis of Cs3Cu2Cl5 nanocrystals
records.method: Prepare Cs-oleate in ODE, prepare CuCl/ligand mixture under vacuum/N2, inject at 160 °C and cool after 5 s.

records.title: Room-temperature antisolvent synthesis of cesium copper halide nanocrystals
records.method: Room-temperature antisolvent recrystallization. Exact salt charges are supplied for the Cs3Cu2Cl5 example; other compositions are stated to use the same or similar method without complete charges.
